title: Spatial Navigation: compact pathfinder and transient breadcrumb strip
creator: Mira Patel
description: Problem: Our current left rail and workspace switcher consume vertical real estate and force users into deep hierarchical clicks to move between models, routes, and rollout lenses. Goal: Propose and validate a compact ‘Spatial Navigation’ pattern that reduces steps to switch context (workspace/model/route), surfaces transient breadcrumbs for quick backtracking, and preserves visibility for cost & rollout lenses in the dashboard flow. Scope: - Low-fidelity -> clickable prototype for core flows (workspace switch, model route change, open rollout canary) - Interaction spec for transient breadcrumb behavior, keyboard shortcuts, and collapsed/expanded states - Accessibility notes (focus order, screen-reader labels, contrast) Deliverables: 1) Figma prototype with annotated flows 2) PRD section for engineering handoff (API hooks & telemetry points) 3) Usability script + 6 moderated test sessions
acceptance_criteria: Clickable prototype demonstrates switching between at least three workspace/model contexts with <=2 clicks
Transient breadcrumb appears along top of content area and supports back/forward navigation and keyboard focus
Collapsed navigation preserves primary routes (Dashboard, Models, Deployments, Billing) and reveals secondary actions on hover/focus
Prototype includes explicit behavior for rollouts: canary badge, quick-rollback CTA, and route preview in a tooltip
Accessibility: all interactive elements reachable by keyboard and labelled for screen readers
decisions: Use a thin, collapsible left rail (40px collapsed) with icon-only primary routes to save horizontal space
Introduce a transient breadcrumb strip anchored to content header rather than top nav to avoid competing chrome
Keyboard shortcut: Cmd/Ctrl+K opens a contextual pathfinder overlay for quick switching between workspaces/routes
Rollout quick actions will be surfaced as context chips in the breadcrumb strip with micro-interactions (hover preview, confirm rollback)
feedback: PM (Jordan Brooks): prefers minimal changes to existing API shape; wants telemetry hooks for switch frequency
Eng (Priya Nair): kernel/plumbing OK but needs clear list of telemetry events and guardrails for route prefetch impact
Security (Carlos Mendes): ensure workspace-switch events are recorded in audit logs in Private deployments
UX Research (Amelie Laurent): validate whether transient breadcrumbs are discoverable in first 3 tasks; recommend onboarding tooltip
